messages.name: int
messages.description: If there is only one argument, and the input is greater than the argument, and the previous input was not greater than or equal to it,sends aout the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: The numbers in the list are compared to the arguments. If all of the numbers in the list are greater than or equal to the corresponding arguments, ais sent out the outlet. Before ais sent again, however,must receive amessage, or must receive another list in which the number that equaled or exceeded its argument goes back below (is less than) its argument.
